subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Modern schools must manage modern objects.”?
options: A mistake during practice is useful if people learn before real danger comes.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.
Electricity may be everywhere, but using it carelessly can turn convenience into danger.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A mistake during practice is useful if people learn before real danger comes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Modern schools must manage modern objects. Electricity may be everywhere, but using it carelessly can turn convenience into danger.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Modern schools must manage modern objects. Electricity may be everywhere, but using it carelessly can turn convenience into danger.」，答案為「Electricity may be everywhere, but using it carelessly can turn convenience into danger.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Electricity may be everywhere, but using it carelessly can turn convenience into danger.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
